verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents its own rule-like automation in two forms. Sandbox expiration policies automatically delete sandboxes on conditions such as inactivity or TTL. Sandbox schedules and scheduled jobs run commands on cron, at a future datetime, or after a delay. These are fixed-purpose or time-based triggers, not a general user-defined event→action rules engine. Missing for 10: general event-driven triggers (e.g., on file change, process exit, or external event), user-configurable choice of actions beyond deletion or a scheduled command, an inbound event or webhook trigger mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.
